build_dm_robotics_extension: build the dm_robotics-controllers Python extension using CMake and the CMakeBuild custom command class
create_cmake_extension: create a CMakeExtension instance to record the source directory and cmake executable for a setuptools extension
build_with_preinstalled_libs: build the extension using pre-installed libraries by setting DM_ROBOTICS_USE_PREINSTALLED_LIBRARIES environment variable
parse_requirements_file: parse a requirements.txt file into a list of dependencies using the _get_requirements helper function
configure_setup_metadata: configure the setuptools metadata for dm_robotics-controllers including version, license, and Python version requirements
